name: Amy Hawkins
source:
A social butterfly, chipper, and everything that Aurora isn't, Amy Hawkins seems elated to see Aurora after a ghost invades her house. But the Amy she meets is nothing like the real thing—she's cold, calculating, and predatory. The way she sneers sends chills up Aurora's spine.

In actuality, Amy is the victim of a ghostly possession. And somehow, that's less scary than what Amy really is inside.

[From [url=https://sapphicore.itch.io/possessed-by-fate]official profile[/url]]
